method: infercnv official R package;independent donor runs;two disjoint T-reference splits
target: all myeloid cells in eligible donors, tumor and adjacent
reference: same donor T cells excluding author NK/NK-like/IFN classes;two disjoint pools stratified by tissue;50minimum per pool
controls: other reference split held out;B cells up to50 and author malignant tumor epithelium up to100;controls not used as anchors
coordinate_source: GENCODEv36 GRCh38/Ensembl102;exact unique Ensembl stable ID mapping;autosomes only
coordinate_build_scope: reference coordinates chosen explicitly for gene ordering, not new verification of original alignment build
gtf_header: ##description: evidence-based annotation of the human genome (GRCh38), version 36 (Ensembl 102)
scope: RNA-inferred broad copy-number-like signal, not DNA CNV or malignancy classification;HMM disabled, no discrete CNV calls;disjoint reference sensitivity not independent cohort validation

software_infercnv.runtime: server165 local disk; explicit package specification archived

summary_method.score: per-cell mean(abs(denoised ratio - 1)); cohort median of donor means
summary_method.bins: 10 Mb; minimum 10 retained genes per donor bin; mean log2 ratios
summary_method.cohort_heatmap: donor-equal means; color display clipped +/-0.25; not classification cutoff
summary_method.reference_sensitivity: Spearman correlation and mean absolute log2 difference across common evaluable bins per donor/group
summary_method.paired_comparison: same donor, same subtype; descriptive score direction and 10Mb differences; no new P/q tests
summary_method.cell_reference_sensitivity: same myeloid cell across common bins, Spearman correlation
summary_method.reference_sensitivity_group_exclusion: T reference and holdout swap membership, excluded from matched-group correlations
summary_method.missing_bin_display: gray; no value substituted; per-bin donor count supplied in tables
